commands.command: set -e; EXPECTED=efde858c5fbae7ab9f2c36b68c68890ca9feacaf; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; echo pre_call_state=$(state); test "$(state)" = "0"; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); echo apk=$APK; echo '=== open-abort ==='; set +e; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe open-abort-offcall" 2>&1; A=$?; echo open_abort_exit=$A; echo '=== start-offcall ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe start-offcall" 2>&1; B=$?; echo start_offcall_exit=$B; set -e; echo post_call_state=$(state); test "$(state)" = "0"; echo phase2_downlink_system_context_v2_diagnostic_complete=true
